m200_20kw_base.name: 200_45 - 20 kW (baseline)
m200_20kw_base.description: Aerostator 20 kW air-cooled, OD 200mm, stack 45mm, 18 turns. Linear 4/3 scale of the 150mm design. Rated 96.7 Nm @ 2000 rpm, 168 A.

m200_20kw_opt.name: 200_45 - 20 kW (optimized)
m200_20kw_opt.description: Ripple-optimized Ø200 20 kW: ripple 1.23% (was 3.26%), T_avg 95.2 Nm @ 2000 rpm, gamma -10.0.

motor_100mm.name: 100 mm · 24s/28p mid-torque
motor_100mm.description: 100 mm spoke-PM inrunner, 24 slots / 28 poles. 6.0 N·m, 2.39 kW @ 3 800 rpm, 93.1 % eff (FEM) at 46 A, 29.4 V phase-peak — fits the 14-cell (≈50 V) bus. OPTIMIZED: teeth widened 5.0→6.5 mm to relieve saturation + 10 turns of thicker wire → +2.8 pp efficiency vs the first cut, same torque & voltage. F45SH magnets, JFE 20JNEH1200 steel. MTPA γ=+12° (legacy frame: -36°).

gamma_reannotation.frame: q-axis at gamma=0, d-axis auto-calibrated per machine (fem_solver_2d._resolve_daxis_shift); d3ab7cb and later
gamma_reannotation.legacy_frame: hard-coded DAXIS_SHIFT_DEG = 108 deg for every topology
gamma_reannotation.calibration_converged: 24/24 frames, 0 Newton fallbacks, worst residual 9.98e-08 against tol 1e-3, 117.4 s
gamma_reannotation.note: Same PHYSICAL current angle, relabelled. The stored number was written when every solve used DAXIS = 108 deg; this machine's calibrated d-axis is 60 deg, so gamma moves by +48 deg to keep the operating point where it was.

my_motor_40mm.name: 40 mm · 12s/14p high-speed
my_motor_40mm.description: 30 mm spoke-PM inrunner, 12 slots / 14 poles, 10 mm stack, wire 2×0.5 mm 6t, F45SH 120C magnets, B15AHV950M steel. γ=+10°, already in the calibrated d-axis frame (saved 2026-07-30, after d3ab7cb). Its OWN measured reference is 0.2286 N·m, 92.5 % at 15 000 rpm / 32 A (scripts/solver_trials.py, 2026-07-30).
